_provenance: RABBIT v2.0 foundation F12. Single source of truth for observational constraints used by inference/likelihood layers. Replaces the three inline copies in forward_likelihood.py, bbn_inference.py, sampler.py. Versioned so future updates (e.g. PDG re-evaluation, new D/H measurements) carry an explicit version tag.

Yp._notes: Helium-4 mass fraction from low-metallicity HII region regression.

DH._notes: Deuterium-to-hydrogen ratio from precision QSO absorber sample.

Li7H._notes: Spite plateau lithium; the cosmological lithium problem leaves this discrepant with BBN by ~3x. Use with caution; gated off by default in BBNLikelihood.
